metadata.title: Topotecan Monotherapy – 5 day
metadata.indication: Relapsed SCLC when retreatment with first-line therapy is not appropriate.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source-reconciled organ-function encoding · clinical/pharmacy review pending

organ_function_reconciliation.note: Structured renal/hepatic component rules were reconciled to the current official NCCP regimen source. Independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation remains pending.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00311 Version 4. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Source reconciled in SACTCheck v0.59.0; independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation pending.

indications.description: Relapsed SCLC when retreatment with first-line therapy is not appropriate.
Metastatic ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer after failure of prior therapy.

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

febrile_or_active_infection.label: Fever, febrile neutropenia or active infection requiring treatment

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst relevant non-haematological toxicity

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Grade 2 under the named CTCAE term: generally moderate; local/non-invasive intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Grade 3 under the named CTCAE term: severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event, grade it with its own CTCAE criteria and assess functional impact before selecting a grade.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded restriction was triggered in the entered domain(s). This is not an overall treatment clearance.
